newsitem.title: USA: U.S. tax bill to have oil/gas measure - lawmakers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tax bill to have oil/gas measure - lawmakers.

text.p: The final version of the tax relief bill working through Congress will have a measure to encourage continued use and development of marginal and low-producing oil and natural gas wells, two Oklahoma lawmakers said.

The bill will suspend the property-income limitation for percentage depletion of marginal oil and gas properties for two years, starting in 1998, Sen. Don Nickles and Rep. Wes Watkins, both Republicans, said in a statement.

"Our provision is directed at ending the tax penalties on the most economically at-risk segment of the domestic oil and natural gas industry. This tax incentive will keep our marginal and stripper wells in operation, in many cases, when oil and gas prices are depressed, rather than producers being forced to pull the plug on wells," Watkins said.
